title: La perífrasis llegar a ser: culminación de un proceso
goal: Deploy the periphrasis 'llegar a ser' to capture the culmination of prolonged endeavor and public recognition.
grammar: perífrasis llegar a ser: culminación de trayectoria vital y logro histórico

items: Highlight long-term effort and perseverance culminating in prominent status.
Apply 'llegar a ser' in biographical and artistic historical portraits.
Avoid using 'llegar a ser' for sudden accidental occurrences.
